说一下剧情，有关nba的剧情只有前五章，主要是完成任务开启抽奖，不喜欢的兄弟可以跳看下个世界。

※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
‘华十二’仿佛处身在无尽的黑暗之中，浑浑噩噩不知过去了多久，忽然一点亮光如同启明星一样出现在远方。
随着那点亮光的出现，黑暗迅速退去。
继而，那亮光迅速退却黑暗，绚丽的光影，嘈杂的声音，纷至沓来。
四周的欢呼声，还有噼里啪啦按下快门的拍照声，让‘华十二’那刚苏醒的思绪终于运转起来。
当他看清周围的一切之后，立刻有些傻眼：“我看到了什么，老科？还是年轻时候的老科，费舍尔”
“咦他们怎么这么矮啊！”
正当‘华十二’怀疑自己是不是在做梦的时候，他感觉手里好像有什么不对，似乎抓着一个球形的物体。
是篮球么？联系周围球场的环境，‘华十二’第一时间想到的就是这个，但应该不是，怎么会这么小。
低头一看，一双皮肤黝黑的巨大手掌中，正抓着一颗篮球，不过那篮球与包裹它的那双巨手相比，仿佛是缩水的儿童玩具篮球一般。
“这是在做梦吗？”
还没等‘华十二’搞清楚状况，就听见‘嘟’的一声，抬头看去，就见一个白人裁判放下哨子，示意发球超时，对方发球。
“嘿，沙克，你没什么问题吧？”
一个带着眼镜，穿着西装的中年人，站在场边大声朝这边问道。
这人喊话的时候用的是英语，奇怪的是，英语成绩向来不算好，且从未出过国的华十二竟然听得清清楚楚，毫不费力。
华十二一眼就认出这个朝他喊话的中年人，竟然是大名鼎鼎的nba冠军教头，禅师‘菲尔·杰克逊’，不过眼前这个比印象中年轻了许多。
‘华十二’是个伪球迷。

伪球迷就是只看自己喜欢明星比赛的那种球迷，‘华十二’就是这一种，乔帮主的公牛，ok的湖人，都是他喜欢的球队，而‘禅师’恰好是乔帮主和ok组合巅峰时期的主教练。
所以即便‘华十二’只是伪球迷，也不影响他熟悉‘禅师’的事情。
‘华十二’的脑子有点乱，禅师管我叫什么，沙克？那不是‘奥尼尔’的名字吗？
等等
‘华十二’再次低头看了看自己这双又黑又大的巨掌，难道，他想起了一种可能，当即将篮球扔给不断示意自己把球交出去的裁判，然后转身朝球员通道跑去。
“嘿，沙克，你在干什么？”
禅师一脸懵逼，场上双方球员也都是如此。
“我去洗手间！”
‘华十二’头也不回的喊了一句，话一出口就意识到自己说的也是英语，而且非常之流利，不由得脚下加快了几分。
球员通道两边的看台上，有球迷朝着‘华十二’欢呼：“沙克，我爱你.”

‘Hua Twelve’ seemed to be in endless darkness, and it was unclear how long it had passed. Suddenly, a bright light appeared in the distance like a morning star.
As that light appeared, the darkness quickly receded.
Then, the light quickly retreated into darkness, and brilliant lights and shadows, as well as noisy sounds, came one after another.
The cheers all around, as well as the snapping of shutters, made the newly awakened thoughts of 'Hua Twelve' finally start to work.
When he saw everything around him clearly, he was immediately dumbfounded: "What did I see, Corvo? It's still Corvo in his youth, Fisher."
"Why are they so short?"
Just when 'Hua Twelve' was wondering if he was dreaming, he felt something was wrong in his hand, as if he was holding a spherical object.
Is it basketball? Considering the environment of the surrounding stadium, this is the first thing that comes to mind for ‘Hua Twelve’, but it shouldn’t be, why is it so small.
Looking down, he saw a pair of huge dark-skinned palms holding a basketball, but compared to the giant hands wrapping it, the basketball seemed like a shrunken children's toy basketball.
"Is this a dream?"
Before 'Hua Twelve' could figure out the situation, he heard a 'beep' sound. He looked up and saw a white referee put down his whistle, signaling that the serve was timed out and the opponent was to serve.
"Hey, Shaq, what's wrong with you?"
A middle-aged man wearing glasses and a suit stood on the sidelines and asked loudly.
This person was speaking in English. What was strange was that Hua Twelve, who had never been very good at English and had never been abroad, could hear it clearly and effortlessly.
Hua Twelve recognized the middle-aged man who shouted to him at a glance. He turned out to be the famous NBA champion coach, Zen Master Phil Jackson, but the man in front of him was much younger than he remembered.
‘Hua Twelve’ is a fake football fan.
Fake fans are the kind of fans who only watch the games of their favorite stars. 'Hua Twelve' is this type. Joe's Bulls and OK's Lakers are his favorite teams, and 'Zen Master' happened to be the head coach of Joe and OK at their peak.
Therefore, even if ‘Hua Twelve’ is just a pseudo-fan, it will not affect his familiarity with ‘Zen Master’.
‘Hua Twelve’ is a little confused. What does the Zen Master call me, Shaq? Isn't that the name of 'O'Neal'?
Wait
'Hua Twelve' looked down at his big black hands again. Could it be that he thought of a possibility and immediately threw the basketball to the referee who kept signaling for him to hand it over, then turned and ran towards the player tunnel.
"Hey, Shaq, what are you doing?"
Zen Master looked confused, as did the players on both sides of the field.
"I'm going to the bathroom!"
"Hua Twelve" shouted without looking back. As soon as he said the words, he realized that he was also speaking English, and he was very fluent. He couldn't help but speed up his steps a little.
In the stands on both sides of the player tunnel, fans cheered towards ‘Hua Twelve’: “Shaq, I love you.”
